title: Phased release integrity checker with autonomous revert policy
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Build a phased-release integrity checker service that evaluates quality and safety signals during progressive exposure (staged % traffic increases) and can autonomously trigger a revert when configurable multi-signal thresholds are breached. The service should operate as a lightweight sidecar to the rollout controller and integrate with existing eval pipelines, metrics (RUM/agent-side telemetry), and the Console to surface actionable insights.
acceptance_criteria: Service evaluates a standard probe set (golden prompts + synthetic cohorts) at each release stage and emits per-stage pass/fail with five core metrics: regression_rate, hallucination_incidents, avg_latency_p50, token_error_rate, and policy_violation_rate
Rollback policy executes automatically when two or more signals exceed configured severity within the stage window, and the rollback is recorded in audit logs with the reason and metric diffs
Console shows a per-stage breakdown including confidence intervals and explanatory traces and links to failing examples
Operators can override automatic reverts within a configurable grace window and add a manual reason; override events are audited
Integration tests validate coordination between rollout controller, integrity checker, and the deployment actuator in a simulated staged rollout environment
technical_notes: Will reuse existing eval harness (evals-service) for golden prompt execution; implement streaming result propagation to allow early aborts. Add a lightweight aggregator service (integrity-checker) that subscribes to per-cohort eval outputs and live telemetry from the serving runtime. Use a configurable rules engine: severity thresholds, correlation window (30s-5m), required_signals_to_fire (default 2). For low-latency decisions prefer moving majority of logic into runtime near the decision plane (sidecar) and keep heavy analysis to backend for postmortem. Consider edge cases: noisy metrics during scaling events, transient backend errors — include debounce and minimum sample counts. Add feature flag to enable for dedicated/private customers first.
rollout_plan: Phase 0: feature-flagged experiment in staging with synthetic traffic only (2 weeks). Phase 1: Pilot on internal non-critical model routes at 1% traffic with live user-sampler cohort (3 weeks). Phase 2: Expand to 10% and then 30% if no regressions (each stage ~1 week). Phase 3: Default-on for specific release types with post-deploy monitoring and 24h observation window. Rollback choreography: integrity-checker -> rollout-controller -> deployment-actuator; include a canary-fallback variant in model catalog for immediate fallback. Detailed playbook in Confluence.
monitoring_playbook: On breach: integrity-checker posts detailed revert reason to Console, triggers automatic rollback and creates a high-priority ticket with attached failing examples and metric diffs. PagerAlert if customer_impact=high and rollback failed to restore baseline. Post-incident: run automated regression eval suite against pinned baseline and candidate; collect per-example diffs; schedule RCA meeting within 48h.
progress_updates: 2026-01-22: Initial spike complete. Confirmed eval harness can run golden prompts at production QPS using synthetic driver. Memory overhead ~3% with streaming enabled. - Sofia

2026-01-29: Architectural review with runtime and infra teams: agreed to implement decision sidecar for lower latency and aggregated backend for audit & analysis. Action: ENG-21532 created to prototype sidecar API. - Marcus
2026-02-10: PoC sidecar can subscribe to per-request traces and forward the minimal evaluation payload (example_id, metrics). Observed 120ms median decision latency in staging. - Marcus

2026-02-24: Rule engine MVP implemented. Default rule: if regression_rate increase >4% AND hallucination_incidents >5 per 1k requests in 5-minute window -> fire. Tuned debounce to 90s to avoid flapping. - Sofia

2026-03-02: Integration test harness wired to rollout-controller. End-to-end simulated staged rollout shows correct automatic revert and audit log entry. Filed design follow-ups: add manual-override UI and expand telemetry sampling. - Marcus

2026-03-10: Security reviewed scope (no sensitive payloads persisted); decided store only tokenized examples and hashed user IDs. Security review complete and documented. Preparing pilot schedule for internal routes next week. - Sofia
